cloudMetadata.normalization: bounding-box center; longest extent equals one
cloudMetadata.normalOrientation: PCA normal's largest-magnitude component is positive
cloudMetadata.sourceIdPolicy: PLY source_id/vertex_id/id when supplied; otherwise original vertex index
cloudMetadata.curvatureDefinition: smallest local PCA eigenvalue / sum of eigenvalues
cloudMetadata.appearanceDefinition: linear-RGB inner-neighborhood mean versus outer-ring mean; Euclidean difference / sqrt(3)
cloudMetadata.featureScaling: divide by 95th percentile and clamp; maximum fallback for sparse features
cloudMetadata.confidenceDefinition: (middle - smallest PCA eigenvalue) / middle; small-neighborhood coverage factor
cloudMetadata.radiusDefinition: half the median distance to up to six nearest neighbors; minimum 0.00001
cloudMetadata.noiseDefinition: Gaussian displacement as a fraction of original longest extent; keyed to persistent source ID

groups.name: slender cylinder
groups.surface: y axis; radius=0.012; axis at x=0.70,z=0.28; y in [-0.56,0.50]

notes: Synthetic inputs do not establish generalization to real scans.
Readback synchronizes GPU. Selection timings are CPU wall time, not FPS or GPU performance.
Full-point image is a same-shader reference, not geometric ground truth.
All variants advance at fixed 30Hz using the same candidate pool, including union-retained IDs.
Temporal residual is weighted by valid reference correspondences; cuts are excluded.
Octree traversal is a prototype: streaming, per-level footprints and large-scale optimization remain pending.
